s2.ptxt: Check that the pulley locks when turned clockwise and turns smoothly when turned counterclockwise.
Using vernier calipers, measure the exposed length of the brushes.

atten4.ptxt: If the exposed length of the brush is less than the minimum, replace the alternator brush holder assembly.

s3.ptxt: Turn the alternator rotor bearing and check that it is not noisy and does not bind.

atten4.ptxt: If the bearing is noisy or binds, replace the alternator rotor assembly.

s3.ptxt: Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the resistance between the slip rings.

atten4.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, replace the alternator rotor assembly.

s3.ptxt: Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the resistance between the slip ring and rotor core.

atten4.ptxt: If the result is not as specified, replace the alternator rotor assembly.

s3.ptxt: Using vernier calipers, measure the diameter of the slip rings.

item.ptxt: If the result is not as specified (slip ring surface is rough), smooth it with sandpaper (#400).
If the diameter is less than the minimum, replace the alternator rotor assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Alternator Drive End Frame Bearing

s2.ptxt: Turn the alternator drive end frame bearing and check that it is not noisy and does not bind.

atten4.ptxt: If the bearing is noisy or binds, replace the alternator drive end frame bearing.
